note: FAOSTAT reports Belgium-Luxembourg (15, BLX-1850-1999) through 1999 and Belgium (255) and Luxembourg (256) from 2000; the support carries only the two members, so 15's cells are their union.
Viet Nam (237) is F237-1954-1975, the combined reporting of North and South Vietnam; the support carries only the two members, so 237's cells are their union.
Yemen (249) is F249-1918-1990; in 1961 the support carries its two predecessors, the Mutawakkilite Kingdom and Aden, so 249's cells are their union.

From 1962 the support carries no complete Yemeni predecessor (MKY-1918-1962 has ended, ADE-1839-1963 ends in 1963, and North and South Yemen have no geometry), so 249 is placed on the cells of modern Yemen.
